task.goal: Among melanoma studies involving pembrolizumab starting in 2015 through 2025 inclusive, identify the top three sponsors sharing drugs with Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, show the shared-drug sponsor network, and compare annual study-start counts for the selected sponsors.

goals.description: Build the complete sponsor-shared-drug network within the specified population and select the top three sponsors connected to Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC.
Compare annual study-start counts for the three selected sponsor cohorts.

artifacts.metric: Number of distinct shared DRUG/BIOLOGICAL identities per sponsor pair; supporting trials are counted separately.

analysis_parameters.title: Shared-drug sponsor network: melanoma studies involving pembrolizumab, starts 2015–2025

assumptions: Operation: network; grouping: sponsor_shared_drug. Start-year bounds are inclusive.
metadata.country_policy: A country count includes studies listing any site there. Country filters also restrict country-chart categories. Study-level RECRUITING does not imply each site is recruiting.
metadata.date_policy: Year filters always use study start year; time-series x-axis uses the declared time_field. Actual and estimated start dates are included.
metadata.enrollment_policy: Missing enrollment excluded; actual/estimated values retained and optionally filtered. Histogram bins are left-closed/right-open; last bin is right-closed.

legacy_plan.title: Shared-drug sponsor network: melanoma studies involving pembrolizumab, starts 2015–2025

metadata.metric_definition: Number of distinct shared DRUG/BIOLOGICAL identities per sponsor pair; supporting trials are counted separately.
metadata.node_count_scope: Union of supporting trials on displayed edges
metadata.phase_policy: Combined phases remain one combined category. Missing phases are Not reported.
metadata.relationship_limits: Drug co-occurrence means same study, not same arm. Shared-drug sponsor edges indicate shared interventions, not collaboration or ownership.
metadata.sorting: Years ascending; phases in clinical order; other categories by descending total count then label; network edges by descending weight then IDs.
metadata.source_semantics: Official ClinicalTrials.gov condition/intervention/lead-sponsor search; other filters use snapshot fields.
